
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- data_logger.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- UNSAVED STORAGE -- data_logger.volt:7[/yellow bold]

Storage variable `log_count` is never saved, so it resets to its default on every boot.

 [dim]6 |[/dim] 
 [dim]7 |[/dim] storage log_count: int = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Call `storage.save("log_count", log_count)` after changing it.[/cyan]
